title: RCC7 dedicated faucet produces nothing
shortDescription: Feed valve, tank valve, or saddle valve closed.
fullDescription: iSpring RCC7 is a 5-stage RO. If the feed valve, the tank ball valve, or the saddle valve is closed, no water reaches the faucet. Confirm all three valves before deeper diagnostics.

fixSteps.title: Open all valves
fixSteps.instruction: Verify feed, tank, and any inline valves are fully open.

title: Trickle flow from RO faucet
shortDescription: Tank air pressure low, or pre-filters spent.
fullDescription: Storage tank should pre-charge at 7 psi when empty. Air loss is the most common cause of slow flow. Recharge with a bicycle pump after draining the tank.

fixSteps.title: Check tank PSI
fixSteps.instruction: Drain tank fully, set 7 psi at Schrader valve under blue cap.

title: Membrane no longer rejects properly
shortDescription: Output TDS exceeds 50 ppm or half of inlet.
fullDescription: RCC7 membrane is rated 75 GPD. After 2-4 years rejection drops. Check pre-filter age first - chlorine attack will destroy a membrane in months.

fixSteps.title: Replace membrane
fixSteps.instruction: Shut feed, twist out membrane housing cap, remove old, install new with O-ring lubed.

faq.a: Yes - flush with food-safe sanitizer first.

title: Housing O-ring leak after filter change
shortDescription: Big-blue housing O-ring not seated or not lubricated.
fullDescription: Filter housings rely on a single round O-ring at the top. After cartridge replacement the O-ring can roll out of its groove. Lubricate with food-grade silicone and confirm the ring seats flat.

fixSteps.title: Reseat O-ring
fixSteps.instruction: Remove housing, lubricate O-ring with silicone, reinstall hand-tight then a quarter turn with the wrench.

title: Continuous drain flow
fullDescription: The system should stop producing once tank reaches 2/3 inlet pressure. If hiss is constant, the auto shut-off valve has failed and water runs to drain non-stop.

causes.cause: Bad check valve at membrane outlet

fixSteps.title: Replace ASOV
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect 4 tubes, install new ASOV in same orientation.

title: Faucet sputters after install
shortDescription: Trapped air in tank and lines.
fullDescription: After install, drain the tank 2-3 times to purge air. This is normal and resolves within a day or two of normal use.

fixSteps.title: Purge tank
fixSteps.instruction: Open faucet for 10 minutes, refill, repeat 3 times.

title: RCC7P-AK6 UV stage lamp fault
fullDescription: iSpring 6-stage UV models include a UV ballast with lamp life monitor. After 9000 hours an audible alarm sounds and the lamp icon flashes. Replace lamp and reset.

fixSteps.title: Replace UV lamp
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, remove top cap, swap lamp wearing gloves, reseat connector.

faq.a: No - skin oils etch the lamp.

title: Storage tank seam rusted
shortDescription: Steel tank shell rusted through after long service.
fullDescription: After 10+ years RO tanks can leak from the seam or threaded port. Tanks are not repairable - swap for new.

fixSteps.title: Replace tank
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect, swap new 3.2 gal tank, Teflon at threaded port only.

title: Inline post-filter coupling leak
fullDescription: The inline post-carbon has push-in elbows. After a filter change the tube can sit just past the first lip. Press in firmly past the second lip.

fixSteps.title: Reseat tube
fixSteps.instruction: Press collet, pull tube, recut, push back firmly.

title: Strange taste from RCC7
fullDescription: If RO water tastes off, drain the full tank to refresh. Replace the inline coconut shell carbon if taste persists.
